name: Munna Bhai Nahi
visual_description: Munna Bhai (Sanjay Dutt) wearing a light blue shirt looking blankly forward with yellow subtitle text saying 'Nahi'.
usage_context: Used to express an immediate, blunt, or matter-of-fact refusal to an unreasonable request or proposal.

example.caption: Can you do overtime today without extra pay?

text_areas.description: The setup or proposal being bluntly rejected
